name: Kataldhar Waterfall
tagline: A 350-foot plunge you can view from a cave behind the falling water
seoTitle: Kataldhar Waterfall Solo Trek Guide — The Solo Trail
seoDescription: Solo trekker's guide to Kataldhar Waterfall near Rajmachi — the cave-behind-the-falls viewpoint, monsoon safety, and packing.

seasons.label: Jun – Sep
seasons.sub: Monsoon — the falls are at peak water volume

seasons.label: Oct – Feb
seasons.sub: Reduced flow but safer footing near the base

seasons.label: Mar – May
seasons.sub: Falls likely reduced to a trickle or dry

routeOptions.name: From Rajmachi village
routeOptions.notes: Steep descents and rocky terrain on the approach to the ~350 ft plunge and the cave viewpoint behind it.

safety.intro: The main risk here is exactly what makes it appealing — getting close to a powerful waterfall's plunge pool.

alerts.title: Slippery rocks and drowning risk near the plunge pool
alerts.body: As water volume increases in monsoon, the rocks near the base become more slippery and the pool current stronger. Do not swim or wade close to the base in heavy flow, and keep photography distance from the edge.

cards.title: Before you go
items: Check recent rainfall — heavier flow means more slippery approach rocks
Wear proper grip footwear, not sandals, for the descent

cards.title: On the trail
items: Stay back from the plunge pool edge in high flow
The cave-behind-the-falls viewpoint can be slick — move carefully

cards.title: Solo-specific
items: Popular combined stop with Rajmachi fort — usually other trekkers around
Avoid entering the water alone regardless of how inviting it looks
